main_text.p:
[?]afes pauefcant concita,
[?]t celfa montium iuga
[?]tima Vallium loca.

[?],me beatum qui lubens
[?]e, Munde, possim linquere!
[?],Patris æternum Dei
[?]erbum, Volare da mihi
[?]ox expeditopestore
[?]d te piorum Vindicem.

[?]Dum mente Vseluogaudia
[?]uafede cæli nos manent,
[?]uanta quiete perfruor!
[?]on Vita longiorplacet,
[?]igrare terris iam iuuat,
[?]æptumque cursum persequi.

[?],tè, parens Olympice,
[?]e posse, si Velis, scio
[?]anare corpus languidum:
[?]ed si mori me nunc iubes,
[?]aratus ecce sum tuis
[?]arere nutibus Volens.

page.notes: Left edge of the lines is cut off by the scan; the initial letters of several lines are lost and are marked [?]. Several words are doubtful, notably the first word of each line in the first two stanzas, and "Vseluogaudia", "Vita", "Volens" are read with long-s as V-like forms. Running head absent. The first line of the page carries a partial word at the left edge. Lines are printed with a short wide indent; the text is verse, each stanza one paragraph.
